items.title: Proper base change for unbounded complexes of Z/nZ-modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends proper base change to unbounded complexes of Z/nZ-modules (statement lines 18886-18896). The proof (proof lines 18898-18935) reduces to a quasi-compact base, obtains finite cohomological dimension of the two pushforwards from the fibre dimension bound, chooses a K-injective representative with injective terms, and uses the acyclicity lemma together with the usual proper base change theorem in each degree to identify the two complexes. H2: one dimension reduction plus one acyclicity computation, written out.
